textRuns.value: Every Monday at 07:17 Sydney time, GitHub Actions runs the monitor in Docker: it reads official agency news (RSS first, news page fallback, robots.txt checked), keeps what is new and relevant, tags it and estimates its cost and effort, then commits the results to GitHub. This report reads those files over HTTPS: press Refresh to load the latest run.
Transform data > Edit parameters > Dataset: 'bi_export' is a synthetic year that shows every feature; 'data/live' is the real weekly monitor. Branch: 'main'.

Needs action: action required and not yet done. Past target date: needs action and the stated deadline (or published + 30/60/90 days for High/Medium/Low) has passed. Cost: staff hours x loaded hourly rate + external spend. Capacity load: hours the outstanding work needs in a month / hours each role can give to regulatory work.

Tags come from keyword rules and costs from stated assumptions (impact_model.py), not from legal advice or quotes. Some agency sites refuse cloud runners; the Source health table shows which ones answered.
